[SCOPE] Enhanced record reviews apply only to customers classified ELEVATED in the signed classification register. Standard-category records are outside this policy.

[DEFINITION] ELEVATED means an explicit E classification in the register; transaction volume does not itself establish that classification.

[INTERVAL] Complete enhanced record reviews at intervals no longer than nine months, subject to EXCEPTION.

[EXCEPTION] Cases bearing an active X exemption use the interval in Schedule X. This collection does not include Schedule X or individual customer exemption records.

[OWNER] The onboarding desk coordinates enhanced review scheduling.

[EVIDENCE] Store completed review evidence in the controlled review register.

[DEADLINE] Notify the review supervisor within two working days after a review becomes overdue.

[SCOPE] Enhanced record reviews apply only to customers classified ELEVATED in the signed classification register. Standard-category records are outside this policy.

[DEFINITION] ELEVATED means an explicit E classification in the register; transaction volume does not itself establish that classification.

[INTERVAL] Complete enhanced record reviews at intervals no longer than four months, subject to EXCEPTION.

[EXCEPTION] Cases bearing an active X exemption use the interval in Schedule X. This collection does not include Schedule X or individual customer exemption records.

[DEADLINE] Notify the review supervisor within two working days after a review becomes overdue.

[OWNER] The enhanced monitoring desk coordinates enhanced review scheduling.

[EVIDENCE] Keep evidence of completed reviews in the controlled review register.

[CADENCE] Schedule ELEVATED customer reviews every nine months unless an active X exemption applies.

[ROUTING] Send enhanced review scheduling tasks to the onboarding desk.

[RECORD] Store completed review evidence in the controlled review register.

[LATE] Notify the review supervisor within two working days of an overdue review.

[CADENCE] Schedule ELEVATED customer reviews every four months unless an active X exemption applies.

[ROUTING] Send enhanced review scheduling tasks to the enhanced monitoring desk.

[CADENCE] For non-exempt ELEVATED customers, schedule reviews every four months.

[OVERRIDE] For the same non-exempt ELEVATED customers, schedule reviews every nine months. These instructions specify no precedence between CADENCE and OVERRIDE.
[CADENCE] Standard-category customer reviews occur every nine months. This instruction does not cover ELEVATED customers.
